decisions.title: Use Dafny for parsing logic
decisions.context: Need verified CSV parsing and JSON generation.
decisions.decision: Implement CsvParser as a Dafny module with contracts, using parser pattern.
decisions.consequences: Adds Dafny compilation step but ensures correctness.

decisions.title: CLI as io-shell
decisions.context: File I/O and console output are unverified side effects.
decisions.decision: Implement Cli as C# io-shell that calls Dafny parser.
decisions.consequences: Keeps I/O separate from verified logic.

openRisks.mitigation: Add comprehensive test cases and refine parser parameters.
openRisks.description: CSV edge cases (quoted fields, newlines) may not be fully handled.

components.name: CsvParser
components.internals: Uses parser pattern with delimiter and header configuration. Pure logic, no I/O.

testCases.name: Parse simple CSV
testCases.description: Given CSV string with header and two rows, returns JSON array.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ParseCsv returns a JSON string with two objects.

components.responsibility: Parses CSV content into structured records and converts to JSON string.

components.name: Cli
components.internals: Entry point reads file path from args, reads file content, calls CsvParser, writes result to console.

testCases.name: Read file and output JSON
testCases.description: Given a CSV file path, outputs JSON to stdout.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Program reads file, calls parser, writes JSON.

components.responsibility: Reads CSV file from command line argument, invokes CsvParser, writes JSON to stdout.

systemContext: A .NET CLI tool that reads a CSV file and outputs JSON representation.

qualityAttributes.target: CSV parsing and JSON generation must be verified by Dafny contracts.
qualityAttributes.rationale: Ensure accurate transformation of input data.
User requested a 1-file tool; keep design lean.

deploymentTopology: Single executable .NET CLI, run from command line.
